{"items":[{"ref":"R14","coverage_id":"coverage-cacbc29d13023ca4","coverage_title":"选择页：两个时段的有效值提示","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"单选项限定可选时段及服务台，属于有效值限制；计划核对选项文字是否在选择前清楚表达可选值，不增设日期输入格式要求。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-13f449179bd84e8197d0f8a2c5d1479f"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["f9a3ded7e0792d84c6943a92：上午与下午单选项及标签"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R15","coverage_id":"coverage-96f5731b9b05c6fc","coverage_title":"核对页：本机演示提交的后果范围","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"任务卡明确登记只在当前页面生效且可复位，本轮提交不属于高后果操作；未取得完成页不改变此适用性。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20","ev-0b46768007964dbd910ff782c9ba9e7c"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["dfff680431538fcadaeb3b5d：核对信息及提交登记"],"object_ids":["obj-d3ce4fd1711dc9270b9e"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design"]},{"ref":"R16","coverage_id":"coverage-cacbc29d13023ca4","coverage_title":"选择页：两个时段及核对入口","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整选择页的任务入口为带时段和服务台标签的单选项及文字按钮，没有重要图标操作对象；仅限该页。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-13f449179bd84e8197d0f8a2c5d1479f"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["f9a3ded7e0792d84c6943a92：时段单选项与核对信息按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b","obj-19e79bdc189741edbd92"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R16","coverage_id":"coverage-96f5731b9b05c6fc","coverage_title":"核对页：返回与提交入口","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"not_applicable","reason":"完整核对页的返回选择和提交登记均为文字按钮，没有重要图标操作对象；不外推完成页。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-0b46768007964dbd910ff782c9ba9e7c"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["dfff680431538fcadaeb3b5d：返回选择、提交登记"],"object_ids":["obj-888b4bf5c3438e05ff97","obj-d3ce4fd1711dc9270b9e"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design"]},{"ref":"R16","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"完成页：后续操作入口的呈现方式","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"完成页尚无画面，无法确定是否存在重要图标操作；不能用核对页的文字按钮推定完成页也无图标。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20","ev-0b46768007964dbd910ff782c9ba9e7c"],"evidence_needed":["提交执行后的完整完成页及控件信息","若存在重要图标，补充其任务必要性、用户熟悉度及辅助说明"],"object_refs":["TASK3、BR2：待取得的完成页及后续入口"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation"]},{"ref":"R17","coverage_id":"coverage-cacbc29d13023ca4","coverage_title":"选择页：更换为下午后的选中表达","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"单选角色及checked记录确认存在选中项；计划对照更换前后画面，核对标识与实际选中值，不仅依据点击或state_changed。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-13f449179bd84e8197d0f8a2c5d1479f"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["action-b8f547f8617d42b4bddd5856f4fe2912：上午改选下午","f9a3ded7e0792d84c6943a92：两项选中与未选表达"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation"]},{"ref":"R17","coverage_id":"coverage-a46b9cb50cb7b416","coverage_title":"返回选择页：保留项的选中表达","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"applicable","reason":"返回动作及返回后checked记录已提供，可检查保留项的可见表达；BR1未覆盖标记与动作证据不一致，不以该标记替代检查。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20","ev-28ea4802a4da474aab003c94497c5b61","ev-1b92d13208824e079e766fb72b4db903"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["action-6f56e0e799d5429dad297472485e9eaf：返回选择","f9a3ded7e0792d84c6943a92：返回后的下午选项"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]}]}
